SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi.
   C. Explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
   D. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

5. Which statement about Weather and Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate.

   C. Treat Weather and Climate as rumours only.
   D. Say Weather and Climate never happens in Kenya.

   D. Treat Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries as rumours only.
   B. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

9. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.

10. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.
   C. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   D. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

13. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.
   D. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui as rumours only.
   B. Say The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.
   D. Explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Population distribution in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population distribution in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Kenya.
   C. Explain Population distribution in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Population distribution in Kenya as rumours only.

16. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.

----
